programme.title: Big Feast Duel
programme.desc: With expert evaluations from renowned chefs and rigorous testing from food connoisseurs, forty restaurants compete to become the top ten culinary representatives! TV King Moses Chan and TV Queen Katy Kung transform into "Food Guru," meticulously selecting the strongest food guide for the Greater Bay Area based on ten themes including baked pork chop rice, wonton noodles, French toast, roast pigeon, hamburgers, and shrimp dumplings. The team delves into the heart of the restaurants, uncovering their little-known culinary stories. A tasting team composed of renowned chefs, well-known food critics, and discerning celebrities will also secretly visit restaurants, bringing back their honest reviews to the studio. After a round of debate and critique, the top-rated restaurants for each theme will be crowned! Viewers can also vote for their "favorite dish."

programme.title: Gourmet Express
programme.desc: Hong Kong brings together global cuisines, and its unique dishes and down-to-earth fare have captured the close attention of discerning food lovers! Food hosts and presenters such as Icy Wong,Snowy Choi,Carmen Ngai,Carmaney Wong , Jessica Liu , Gillian Ng keep up with the latest food news and deals, delving into the stories behind the flavors. Gathering firsthand information on popular eateries across various platforms, the hosts personally line up and taste the food, providing genuine reviews. Even takeout-only eateries with no dine-in option are in high demand—what are the must-try picks? Running a food business inevitably comes with its own mix of sweet, sour, bitter, and spicy experiences. The production team follows the proprietors through their busy day, from sourcing ingredients and preparing materials to opening for business, uncovering the "stories behind the flavors."

programme.title: Vital Lifeline
programme.desc: Urban dwellers often experience a hectic pace of life and high levels of stress, making them more susceptible to health problems. "The Strongest Lifeline" helps you unravel the secrets to good health. To start, the program features a four-episode series on common urban pain issues, covering headaches, shoulder and neck pain, back pain, and joint pain. Each episode invites medical experts to explain the causes of these conditions, as well as physical therapists and exercise specialists to teach appropriate exercises. With the growing trend of integrating Eastern and Western medicine, even American swimming champion Michael Phelps uses cupping therapy to relieve pain. Therefore, each episode also includes traditional Chinese medical diagnosis, complemented by treatments such as acupuncture, cupping, and the “Sanfu” herbal patch therapy, which is especially suitable during the hottest days of summer. In addition, Chinese medicine practitioners share recipes for nourishing soups, all of which can help regulate and improve your health.

programme.title: Big Boys Club
programme.desc: " Big Boys Club" is a youth talk show hosted by a group of close friends—Bob Lam, Oscar Leung, Derek Wong, Philip Fan, and Alan Chan. In each episode, singers, entertainers, or guests from various fields are invited for relaxed interviews, presenting a wide range of topics including current social issues, pop culture, and trending interests. Matters of love, relationships, and even same-sex relationships are endlessly discussed topics for men and women alike. The show invites guests from diverse backgrounds to explore love and relationships, delving into the dynamics between the sexes. The "Other Dimension" segment features guests sharing extraordinary experiences, such as encounters with ghosts, UFOs, and bizarre happenings, bringing thrilling topics to the audience.

programme.title: Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils (2021)
programme.desc: Mr. Jin Yong created a magnificent martial arts world for readers, and *Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils* is one of the most beloved and sought-after masterpieces in his novel series. Its classic status is self-evident, and it remains a popular subject for adaptation. Set in the Northern Song Dynasty during the reign of Emperor Zhezong, the story follows the adventures, love, and hatred of three characters: Qiao Feng (played by Yang Youning), the leader of the Beggars' Sect; Duan Yu (played by Bai Shu), the prince of Dali; and Xu Zhu (played by Zhang Tianyang), a young monk from Shaolin Temple. It also explores the complex web of martial arts grudges and the inescapable cycle of greed, anger, and delusion, painting a vivid picture of human relationships and symbolizing that all beings in the world are ultimately bound by the painful entanglements brought about by "love."

programme.title: News At 18:30 & Global View & What's On Today
programme.desc: Jade Channel reports important local, cross-strait, and international news every afternoon at 6:30.

programme.title: Scoop 2026
programme.desc: "Scoop" airs from Monday to Sunday, closely following major social events and interesting stories, while also reporting the latest updates in the entertainment industry, celebrity news, as well as drama promotions and behind-the-scenes features. The "Today's Breaking News" segment keeps viewers up to date with the day's hottest stories. The in-depth feature section explores current affairs, social, and livelihood issues that the public cares about, interviewing relevant experts for their insights.

programme.title: Like Mother, Like Daughter
programme.desc: Public relations queen TONG MAN-LEI (Jinny Ng) raises her Gen Z daughter TONG SUM ( Desta Lee) alone and she is a control freak. MAN-LEI's mother, TONG CHO KA-BING (Stephanie Che), has spent half of her life supporting her husband and raising their children. She is suddenly "awakened" and she returns to Hong Kong from Canada. She decides to reclaim her lost time and she moves into MAN-LEI's home. Many years ago, KA-BING and her daughter completely fell out because MAN-LEI insisted to have her daughter out of wedlock. Now, KA-BING suddenly breaks in without warning and disrupts MAN-LEI's life. MAN-LEI strives to maintain order, while TONG SUM mediates between the two, creating sparks and constant conflicts in this three-generation household. In the workplace, the wealthy heir, “Marketing Guru” YEUNG FAN (Gary Chiu), is parachuted into the company to lock horns with MAN-LEI on equal footing. MAN-LEI's career and family are facing crises at the same time.

programme.title: This City Never Sleeps
programme.desc: SLF International Group Chairman Kun Chi Sam (John Chiang) is an influential figure in Macao. This business tycoon arranges for his two sons, Kun Hao In (Julian Cheung) and Kun Hao Kuan (Ron Ng), to serve as Co-CEOs of the group, placing them on equal footing. Hao In always regards Hao Kuan as a thorn in his side. To dismantle the powerful syndicate of Hao Kuan and his wife Wong Suet Ying (Kelly Cheung), Hao In announces his marriage to Hong Kong prosecutor Hung Hoi Wan (Samantha Ko). Hoi Wan and Suet Ying both hail from R. Cino Outubro and were once buddies. However, Suet Ying became the other woman and snatched Hoi Wan's boyfriend as she wanted to marry into a wealthy family. Hao In intends to take advantage of Hoi Wan's hatred by turning it into some weapon to attack Hao Kuan and his wife. In a situation where every family member seems to be scheming, Hao Kuan adheres to righteous principles and boldly deals with Hao In's relentless maneuvers.

programme.title: Mystic Nine
programme.desc: " Mystic Nine" tells the story of Zhang Qishan (William Chan) and Wu Laogou (Joseph Zeng) joining forces with Huo Xiangu (Chen Yao) and the other members of the Nine Gates to embark on an adventure amidst renewed turmoil in Changsha. A mysterious disappearance of Unit 401 uncovers a shocking secret buried for a century. Life-or-death choices, brotherhood, sectarian duty, and national righteousness intertwine. The members of the Nine Gates use their blood and sacrifice to protect their homeland and overcome difficulties together.

programme.title: EXTRA
programme.desc: Report important news about Hong Kong, cross-strait, and international affairs. Stay updated every night with the latest news from Hong Kong's entertainment industry, as well as film and entertainment news from around the world. We report on the newest developments of artists, promotions for TV series and movies, highlights from concerts, and coverage of grand award ceremonies. We even travel abroad to cover major entertainment events, track international movie stars, and conduct exclusive interviews with well-known singers, actors, and television personalities familiar to our audience—ensuring you can instantly grasp the latest happenings and news in the world of film and entertainment.

programme.title: News Roundup
programme.desc: Reporting major news from Hong Kong, across the Taiwan Strait, and around the world, as well as sports updates, keeping you informed about important events and trends in the world of sports.

programme.title: Global View
programme.desc: " Global View," curated by seasoned journalists, guides you to view the world with a global perspective—broadening your horizons, expanding your understanding of the news, and enriching your knowledge.

programme.title: Man Who Kills Troubles, The
programme.desc: K works as a fixer for Kiu Yeh, the triad leader of Hung Wo, in Melbourne. In his last mission in Melbourne, Kiu Yeh himself is found dead at the scene and K is framed for being the murderer. K also saves Jovy who has fainted in the burning building. Kiu Yeh's successor, Kiu Yik Fong, orders John to kill K. John shoots K in the head with an empty bullet to fake his death and then arranges for him to assume a new identity. K chooses to go to Hong Kong as his late girlfriend's family is there and he wants to take care of them for her. His girlfriend was Chloe and she died in a lab explosion that has been concluded as an accident. In Hong Kong, K becomes O Sir, a Physical Education teacher. His students include Ko Chun, Chloe's younger brother. He also chooses to live next door to the Ko family. 2 years later, Jovy turns up at the school as a music teacher and she is partnered with O Sir to handle Ko Chun's class. Together, they help their students with their problems including run-ins with triad members. Jovy reminds O Sir of Chloe as they share many similarities while Jovy herself starts to develop feelings for O Sir. Due to Jovy's family background which exposes her to danger, O Sir has to secretly step in to save her. But how long can O Sir keep his identity a secret? He also discovers that Chloe's death wasn't accidental. So, why did she have to die and who killed her? As Man Sir digs deeper into the triad cases, it changes his life forever. What happened to make him turn from a good cop into a bad one?

programme.title: Brutally Young
programme.desc: Rewind eighteen years and Lam Long-sang (Shaun Tam), Sum King-yat (Joel Chan), Tse Ka-fu (Anthony Ho) and their chums are members of a public housing estate youth septet. They clash with a rascal by the name of Wu Kai-sze, who ultimately collapses and dies. The septet gradually drift apart. They eventually go their separate ways and forget their past. Fast-forward eighteen years and while the police are investigating a traffic accident, they discover Kai-sze's remains. The septet are forced to face up to the disaster they had caused. While the chums are feeling confused, Long-sang is even more perplexed as he and Crime Unit Inspector Yuen Lai-kan (Mandy Wong), who is assigned this human remains case, begin to have affectionate feelings for each other. Meanwhile, Lai-kan's father Yuen Tsun (Dominic Lam) is also covertly unraveling the case and seems to have something to do with the remains. The septet are getting jittery as the truth is surfacing. Who really is the perpetrator?

programme.title: Justice Of Life, The
programme.desc: Mingtian, formerly a powerful figure in the underworld, was devastated by the accidental death of his fiancée during a business deal. Determined to turn over a new leaf, he runs a social club to make a living. Mingtian lives with his mother, uncle He Yingbiao, and cousin He Xinmiao. Yingbiao harbors suspicions that Mingtian was responsible for his dismissal from the police force, and frequently attacks him. Mingtian, however, doesn't hold a grudge. Xinmiao idolizes Mingtian, and the two are like brothers, much to Yingbiao's frustration. Since his fiancée's death, Mingtian's heart has been at peace, but his encounters with Yu Wenqian and Ruan Daiyu stir up his romantic life. Xinmiao, misled by his father, becomes involved in drug trafficking. To save Xinmiao, Mingtian teams up with his old friend, police inspector Ma Shixiong, to fight against the gangsters.

programme.title: From Hong Kong To Beijing
programme.desc: Chui Kong-yan (Ruco Chan), member of a property management company top management, is a lucky guy as his career keeps progressing well. However, he and his wife Helen Kwong (Jinny Ng) inadvertently fall for some investment scam and suffer heavy losses. Kong-yan is reassigned to a branch office as CEO in Beijing. He regards this as an opportunity to turn the situation around, so he and Helen go to the North to start over. But he is affected by a midlife crisis. Kong-yan is actually demoted because of Ding Chi-keung, who used to be his arch enemy. To save face, he just has to stay put. He then again runs into Su Fei (Jacky Cai), who he has not seen for many years, and his marriage is under strain. Gourmet influencer Chui Kong-man (Tony Leung) and busker Chui Po-yee (Joey Thye) each have their reasons for going to the North to seek refuge with their big brother Kong-yan. The family members keep brainstorming and want to transform an abandoned transformer house into a creative park. Kong-yan, who follows Buddhistism, really has to engage in a tough battle for his life!

programme.title: Legend of The Condor Heroes 1994, The
programme.desc: In the Sung Dynasty, the Kwok's and the Yeung's were being wiped out. Luckily, Ching (Julian Cheung) from the Kwok's survived and was brought up by the Seven Strangers in the desert. The Seven Strangers also taught him their Kungfu. Then, he met the lovely and witty Yung (Athena Chu) and they fell in love with each other. They set out for a journey and met Kung (Lau Dan) and Tung (Lai Yiu Cheung). They both taught Ching their knowledge in Kungfu.

programme.desc: Rewind eighteen years and Lam Long-sang (Shaun Tam), Sum King-yat (Joel Chan), Tse Ka-fu (Anthony Ho) and their chums are members of a public housing estate youth septet. They clash with a rascal by the name of Wu Kai-sze, who ultimately collapses and dies. The septet gradually drift apart. They eventually go their separate ways and forget their past. Fast-forward eighteen years and while the police are investigating a traffic accident, they discover Kai-sze's remains. The septet are forced to face up to the disaster they had caused. While the chums are feeling confused, Long-sang is even more perplexed as he and Crime Unit Inspector Yuen Lai-kan (Mandy Wong), who is assigned this human remains case, begin to have affectionate feelings for each other. Meanwhile, Lai-kan's father Yuen Tsun (Dominic Lam) is also covertly unraveling the case and seems to have something to do with the remains. The septet are getting jittery as the truth is surfacing. Who really is the perpetrator?

programme.title: Justice Of Life, The
programme.desc: Mingtian, formerly a powerful figure in the underworld, was devastated by the accidental death of his fiancée during a business deal. Determined to turn over a new leaf, he runs a social club to make a living. Mingtian lives with his mother, uncle He Yingbiao, and cousin He Xinmiao. Yingbiao harbors suspicions that Mingtian was responsible for his dismissal from the police force, and frequently attacks him. Mingtian, however, doesn't hold a grudge. Xinmiao idolizes Mingtian, and the two are like brothers, much to Yingbiao's frustration. Since his fiancée's death, Mingtian's heart has been at peace, but his encounters with Yu Wenqian and Ruan Daiyu stir up his romantic life. Xinmiao, misled by his father, becomes involved in drug trafficking. To save Xinmiao, Mingtian teams up with his old friend, police inspector Ma Shixiong, to fight against the gangsters.

programme.title: From Hong Kong To Beijing
programme.desc: Chui Kong-yan (Ruco Chan), member of a property management company top management, is a lucky guy as his career keeps progressing well. However, he and his wife Helen Kwong (Jinny Ng) inadvertently fall for some investment scam and suffer heavy losses. Kong-yan is reassigned to a branch office as CEO in Beijing. He regards this as an opportunity to turn the situation around, so he and Helen go to the North to start over. But he is affected by a midlife crisis. Kong-yan is actually demoted because of Ding Chi-keung, who used to be his arch enemy. To save face, he just has to stay put. He then again runs into Su Fei (Jacky Cai), who he has not seen for many years, and his marriage is under strain. Gourmet influencer Chui Kong-man (Tony Leung) and busker Chui Po-yee (Joey Thye) each have their reasons for going to the North to seek refuge with their big brother Kong-yan. The family members keep brainstorming and want to transform an abandoned transformer house into a creative park. Kong-yan, who follows Buddhistism, really has to engage in a tough battle for his life!

programme.title: Legend of The Condor Heroes 1994, The
programme.desc: In the Sung Dynasty, the Kwok's and the Yeung's were being wiped out. Luckily, Ching (Julian Cheung) from the Kwok's survived and was brought up by the Seven Strangers in the desert. The Seven Strangers also taught him their Kungfu. Then, he met the lovely and witty Yung (Athena Chu) and they fell in love with each other. They set out for a journey and met Kung (Lau Dan) and Tung (Lai Yiu Cheung). They both taught Ching their knowledge in Kungfu.

programme.title: Man Who Kills Troubles, The
programme.desc: K works as a fixer for Kiu Yeh, the triad leader of Hung Wo, in Melbourne. In his last mission in Melbourne, Kiu Yeh himself is found dead at the scene and K is framed for being the murderer. K also saves Jovy who has fainted in the burning building. Kiu Yeh's successor, Kiu Yik Fong, orders John to kill K. John shoots K in the head with an empty bullet to fake his death and then arranges for him to assume a new identity. K chooses to go to Hong Kong as his late girlfriend's family is there and he wants to take care of them for her. His girlfriend was Chloe and she died in a lab explosion that has been concluded as an accident. In Hong Kong, K becomes O Sir, a Physical Education teacher. His students include Ko Chun, Chloe's younger brother. He also chooses to live next door to the Ko family. 2 years later, Jovy turns up at the school as a music teacher and she is partnered with O Sir to handle Ko Chun's class. Together, they help their students with their problems including run-ins with triad members. Jovy reminds O Sir of Chloe as they share many similarities while Jovy herself starts to develop feelings for O Sir. Due to Jovy's family background which exposes her to danger, O Sir has to secretly step in to save her. But how long can O Sir keep his identity a secret? He also discovers that Chloe's death wasn't accidental. So, why did she have to die and who killed her? As Man Sir digs deeper into the triad cases, it changes his life forever. What happened to make him turn from a good cop into a bad one?

programme.title: A Guilty Conscience
programme.desc: Due to the negligence of sharp-tongued barrister Adrian, his innocent client is convicted of murder and sentenced to 17 years in jail. An opportunity to appeal the case and free his client arises a few years later, but in order to right his wrong, he must fight against one of the most powerful families in Hong Kong for justice to prevail.

programme.title: Shining For One Thing
programme.desc: Zhang Wan Sen plans to confess his crush on Lin Bei Xing after the college entrance exam, but an accident changes everything tragically. As Zhang feels helpless and devastated, he fortuitously travels back in time with Lin before the accident happens. Can he make amends and convey his regrets this time?

programme.title: Shadows
programme.desc: Ching is a forensic psychiatrist who has the power to enter a person's subconscious mind. In her latest case, she suspects that another psychiatrist is responsible for a brutal murder-cum-suicide case involving a social worker. In the investigation process, Ching finds herself under suspicion instead, as she comes face-to-face with a past trauma…

programme.title: Detective Dee And Nine-storey Demon Building
programme.desc: A series of strange incidents happen at the Tang's demon building but Detective Dee finds no clue. Dee finds the master of the family suspicious when he speaks with him, and when the eldest daughter Miss Tang secretly informs Dee about Mr Tang's strange behavior and the fact that she is kept under surveillance, Dee vows to unveil the truth.

programme.title: Last Suspect
programme.desc: Lawyer Chen receives a mysterious call demanding her to defend a murder suspect after her daughter is kidnapped, and is told that she can only save her daughter by winning the case. As she starts investigation with the police and evidence emerges, Chen discovers the truth and reveals the mastermind. Can she rescue her daughter in time?

programme.title: All's Well End's Well Too
programme.desc: Another super comedy directed by Clifton Ko about more farcical couplings, mistaken identities, infidelities, and arranged marriages set in the Sung Dynasty.

programme.title: Crypto Storm
programme.desc: ICAC investigation officer Lok sets up a special team to investigate a corruption case involving a bank's top executive's use of cryptocurrency to manipulate the trading market. When the bank's chairman is kidnapped and kidnappers demand ransom in crypto coins, Lok connects the dots and vows to hunt down the mastermind behind both crimes.

programme.title: MuMu
programme.desc: Mumu, a cheerful seven-year-old girl, lives with her deaf father in a deaf community and connects him to the outside world. However, their peaceful life is disrupted when her estranged mother reappears, pushing Mumu into the hearing world. Meanwhile, her father becomes ensnared by a gang that exploits the deaf to commit crimes.

programme.title: All's Well End's Well (Extended Version)
programme.desc: In this beloved Hong Kong comedy, the three Chang brothers living with their parents learn that love blossoms with nurture, but withers when taken for granted through haste, deceit, and selfishness. This extended version features an additional shootout scene that was omitted from the original theatrical release during Lunar New Year 2016.

programme.title: Cold War
programme.desc: A hijacking of a police van occurs when the Police Commissioner is away from Hong Kong. Deputy Commissioner Lee leads a rescue operation code-named Cold War. Fellow Deputy Commissioner Sean moves to take control from Lee as he thinks Lee is emotionally affected by his son being held hostage, but the efforts end up threatening both their reputation.

programme.title: She’s Got No Name
programme.desc: In 1945 Shanghai, a gruesome murder shocks “Jiang Yuan Nong”. Frail woman Zhan Zhou Shi, driven to despair by years of domestic abuse, kills and dismembers her husband, then remains at the scene to surrender. The case seems clear-cut, yet remains riddled with doubt. As the truth unravels, a shocking reversal rewrites everyone's fate.

programme.title: 8 Bucks Tycoon
programme.desc: When a struggling painter receives a magical wallet that endlessly produces RM8 notes, his life transforms from hardship to luxury. However, is this miracle truly a blessing or a hidden curse?

programme.title: Project Gutenberg
programme.desc: Master counterfeiter Lee Man recounts his rise within a powerful criminal syndicate led by the mysterious “Painter,” whose forged banknotes are indistinguishable from real currency. As police close in, betrayal, deception, and hidden identities blur the line between truth and lies in a dangerous world of crime and manipulation.

programme.title: The Enchanting Ghost
programme.desc: It is love beyond the grave, as a young scholar and his beautiful lover are torn apart forever by his dastardly uncle and his friend, who drive the girl to commit suicide... but with death comes revenge for the enchanting ghost. A spooky yet heart-wrenching tale...

programme.title: Chinatown Kid
programme.desc: After getting into trouble with a local gangster, Chui Ho, in Hong Kong, Tam Dong flees to San Francisco and manages to get a job in a restaurant in Chinatown. Tam Dong finds himself embroiled with the gangsters again in San Francisco, and has to fight Chui Ho when the two meet again...

programme.title: Raw Passions
programme.desc: Mrs Lin's husband and his friend both have affairs with a belly dancer Sasa, and are both blackmailed by her. Sasa is stabbed one day and her brother shows up asking for money. A mysterious man also claims he can offer evidence for cash to help Lin's husband. Lin has to unveil the deceit, double-crosses and blackmailing before she is in danger too!

programme.title: The Venus' Tear Diamond
programme.desc: Legendary rival jewel thieves Fragrant Night and Nocturnal Earl travel to Japan to steal the famous Venus' Tear Diamond. They fall quickly in love at first sight, without knowing the other person is their rival and is after the same prize. Who will get the diamond, and will it mean the end of their new found love?

programme.title: Tragic Commitment
programme.desc: When the husband of a doctor, Tung is fatally wounded in an accident, he reveals to her about his affair with Blackie, who is impregnated with his baby. Despite the devastation of the betrayal and the eventual death of her husband, Tung is pressured by her mother-in-law into putting up with Blackie and offer $1M for her baby...

programme.title: Scandal
programme.desc: The roguish scamp Zhen and his best friend Chia collects proof of corruption from the officials in this comedy-drama. After a string of blackmailing, they end up in positions of power, but what is to happen next?

programme.title: The Duel of the Century
programme.desc: A duel has been arranged at the Forbidden City between two formidable swordsmen of the martial world, Ye Gu Cheng and Xi Men Chui Xue. Lu Xiao Feng smells something fishy about the duel as the two swordsmen never met and do not have any conflicts. He decides to investigate more with Hua Man Lou, and eventually uncovers some hidden conspiracies…

programme.title: The Adulteress
programme.desc: The film is about the drugged, then disgraced wife of a peddler in the waning days of the Ching Dynasty. To make matters worse, she's soon framed for her husband's murder by her rapist, the son of the local magistrate! And even that is not the end of her woes in this emotional suspense…

programme.title: The Fake Ghost Catchers
programme.desc: Huan Zhu's ghost seeks help from “Fake Ghost Catchers” Bao Tuo and Zhou Peng, after a jealous suitor's ghost seeks vengeance by murdering her and now targeting her sister. Together with actor Wu Shun Chao who possesses a supernatural talent, they unite to protect Huan Zhu's sister from both mortal and spectral threats.

programme.title: Long Road To Gallantry
programme.desc: Tu Meng Fei makes his way to the world after completing his kung fu training. En route, he rescues Mu Wan Erh and Li San Nan from a band of thugs and later learnt of a 20-year conflict between the evil Thunder Gang Chief Leng Tian Lei and the Dragon Sect. Mu's lost father is none other than the Thunder Gang Chief, who also killed Li's father…

programme.title: The Convict Killer
programme.desc: After spending fifteen years in prison on trumped-up charges for drug smuggling, the martial arts master Teng Piao embarks on a journey to take revenge on the person who sets him up - “Black Leopard”. Unfortunately for Piao, no one knows the real identity of “Black Leopard”, except that there is a black leopard tattoo on his chest.

programme.title: Double Bliss
programme.desc: Dong and Chu plan to get married but their families who are lifelong rivals, disapproved. They decide to fake suicide and eventually get both of their parents to settle their differences and approve the marriage. Concurrently, a record company announces that they will release Dong's songs, leading to double bliss for the couple.

programme.title: The Boxer From The Temple
programme.desc: A young monk, The Kid, was expelled from the temple due to his crazy ways. After leaving the temple, he fights a cruel bandit's son and befriends a prostitute. As he fights for justice, his “Crazy Lo Han Fist” improves with every fight.

programme.title: Beyond the Great Wall
programme.desc: Wang Zhao Jun refuses to bribe the imperial painter, so he draws an ugly portrait of her, preventing her from being selected by the Emperor until they meet in person. The painter ends up in exile and plots for Wang to marry the Hun's warlord as a revenge. The Emperor rejects this, provoking a war which is only averted when Wang sacrifices herself.

programme.title: Pursuit
programme.desc: This movie tells the tale of Lin Chong, the Sung Dynasty's Chief Army Instructor who is framed by a corrupt official and has to embark on an exile fraught with danger. Helped by a monk, Lin Chong is finally able to take revenge.

programme.title: House Mates
programme.desc: Newlyweds Karthik and Anu move into an old apartment where strange events disrupt their lives, pushing them to uncover a paranormal mystery linked to another nearby family.

programme.title: Akhanda 2
programme.desc: As biological warfare threatens the country, a scientist seeks a cure. But when dangerous forces target her, a warrior returns to defend humanity.

programme.title: Veerame Vaagai Soodum
programme.desc: A normal man from a middle-class family questioning the authorities for abusing their powers.

programme.title: Iru Mugan
programme.desc: Following the attack on the Indian Embassy in Malaysia, Akhilan, an ex-agent, is assigned to track down the culprit. His investigations lead him to his old foe who has now developed a hazardous drug.

programme.title: Aakashaganga 2
programme.desc: When Arathi decides to expose an ashram, which claims to help people communicate with the dead, an evil spirit Akashganga, returns to haunt her.

programme.title: Sarkarin Elam
programme.desc: A finance agent is conned by his love interest and travels to India to get his money back from her influential father, who is a Member of Parliament and industrialist.

programme.title: Pheonix
programme.desc: Young Surya, accused of political murder, endures deadly plots in a juvenile reform school while struggling to survive the brutal realities of life behind bars daily.

programme.title: Kuttram 23
programme.desc: ACP Vetrimaaran unravels a crime racket involving medical professionals. However, his task becomes harder every day as the case becomes murkier and complex.

programme.title: Demonte Colony 2
programme.desc: A group of friends who return to a cursed location, driven by curiosity and the quest to uncover the truth behind the malevolent spirits that reside there.

programme.desc: Penyanyi terkenal bernama Chandru yang mengalami hilang ingatan bertemu dengan seorang pemuzik jalanan, Kathira. Namun, timbul misteri apabila Kathira sebenarnya mempunyai hubungan masa lalu dengan Chandru dan merancang semua ini untuk membantunya keluar dari kegelapan dan kembali ke pentas.

programme.title: WOK
programme.desc: Usop cuba dapatkan wok dengan mencari deris. Namun siapa diri deris sudah mulai terbongkar. Dia tidak endah permintaan usop mengenai pemergiaan maimun. Betapa kejamnya deris, tidak langsung membawa wok balik untuk melihat arwah maimun untuk kali terakhir. Wok disiksa teruk dan tekad cuba membunuh deris.

programme.desc: Selepas Mona dilepaskan demi menyelamatkan anaknya, Anom dirawat di pusat psikiatri dan mengawal Mona sepenuhnya. Dakwaan pembunuhan rupanya halusinasi, menimbulkan persoalan tentang kebenaran sebenar di sebalik delusi Mona.

programme.title: Beheading
programme.desc: Sebuah keluarga menjadi sasaran kemurkaan suatu entiti, memaksa mereka mempersembahkan korban kuno dengan mengahwinkan anak perempuan mereka dengan patung semangat leluhur yang tidak berkepala.

programme.title: Nak Dengar Cerita Hantu S2 EP7
programme.desc: Di sebuah rumah banglo lama yang menjadi tempat berkumpulnya Long Samad dan lima orang pelajar, Elina asyik membelek wajahnya melalui sebuah cermin kecil. Long Samad yang baru sahaja membuang sekeping cermin retak tiba-tiba bertanya sama ada Elina pernah memakai susuk.

programme.title: Obsesi Dia EP10
programme.desc: Polis mengatur rancangan untuk memerangkap Amir. Tan Seri Jamaludin hilang sabar kerana Uda masih gagal mendapatkan tanda tangan Zacky. Dia memberhentikan semua kemudahan kewangan Zacky serta mengupah orang melanggar Uda. Sementara itu Zacky berjaya memikat Alia dan sempat menyampaikan hasrat untuk memilikinya. Alia mula terasa pernah melalui hidup bersama Zacky. Emosi dan fikirannya Alia semakin terganggau dan keliru sehingga mengalamai depresi. Sophie pula tidak sabar memiliki Zacky untuk mengaut harta. Rafeeq mengarah orang-orang untuk terus menjejaki Zacky dan Alia

programme.title: Kung Fu Yoga
programme.desc: Jack, seorang profesor arkeologi yang terkenal di dunia, dan pasukannya sedang dalam pencarian besar-besaran untuk mencari harta karun purba India yang hilang apabila mereka diserang hendap oleh sekumpulan tentera upahan dan dibiarkan mati.

programme.title: Highland Tower
programme.desc: Pada Disember 1993, sebuah blok kondominium mewah runtuh selepas hakisan tanah dari lereng bukit bersebelahan. Kira-kira 50 orang terkorban dan kejadian ini sehingga kini menjadi salah satu tragedi paling gelap dan menyedihkan dalam sejarah Malaysia. Dua puluh tahun kemudian, pada 2013, sekumpulan pembuat filem dokumentari menjelajah ke dua blok yang masih berdiri untuk menjalankan ekspedisi memburu hantu. Apa yang mereka temui tidak sesuai untuk mereka yang lemah semangat.

programme.title: Bonnie
programme.desc: Bonnie, seorang remaja sekolah menengah, mempunyai masa lalu yang kelam. Walau bagaimanapun, berbekalkan kemahiran seni mempertahankan diri, dia mampu bertahan untuk melindungi dirinya malah orang-orangnya.

programme.title: Penunggu Istana
programme.desc: Video realiti ini mengisahkan tentang pengalaman beberapa jurugambar dan lain-lain krew penggambaran yang sedang mengadakan satu tugas penggambaran sejenis makhluk asing yang dikatakan ada menghuni sebuah bangunan lama berupakan Istana Billah yang dibina pada 1896 di satu pekan kecil Papan, Perak. Sekumpulan penyelidik terdiri krew dan kakitangan yang terdiri beberapa lelaki dan wanita dengan penuh semangat dan dedikasi telah pergi ke lokasi tempat yang dikatakan terdapatnya makhluk / penunggu yang penuh misteri itu.Krew itu pada mulanya sangat gembira dan penuh dedikasi itu,telah mengalami kejadian ganjil,ngeri dan penuh trauma .Tempat mereka bermalam itu, yang merupakan istana bangunan lama telah bergoyang dengan sendirinya. Setelah di umpankan dengan benda-benda pelik oleh makhluk halus. Penunggu misteri itu akhirnya telah keluar dan membunuh dua krew itu iaitu Mus dan Fira. Seorang lagi penyelidik bernama Amar telah hilang.

programme.desc: Rancangan ini diterajui oleh pengantara Detik 12 Malam iaitu Saiful AzmiJamsari serta dibantu oleh krew-krew produksi sebagai pembantu penyiasatan. Kali ini pengantara berada di Menara Tinjau terletak Bukit Ampang tidak jauh dari Kuala Lumpur. Kawasan ini di bawah pengawasan Jabatan Perhutanan yang telah dibuka pada 2006. Mereka pernah diganggu dengan lembaga Pocong yang menakutkan dan bau busuk semasa bertugas pada waktu malam. Pengantara bersama krew kemudiannya melakukan penyiasatan dengan berada di situ selepas 12 malam. Mereka sendiri mengalami situasi bunyi dan bau busuk yang menakutkan sama saperti diceritakan.

Selepas kematian Pak Chad, Liz meninggalkan kampung halamannya dan pergi ke rumah Datuk Kamarul, rakan seperjuangan bapanya yang kini sudah berjaya dalam bidang politik dan perniagaan di Petaling Jaya. Datuk Kamarul mempunyai dua orang anak iaitu Zamri dan Zaiton. Liz kemudiannya menjadi anak angkat kepada Datuk Kamarul dan menyambung persekolahannya dalam aliran sastera. Kehadiran Liz dalam keluarga itu telah membuatkan hubungan Zamri dan kekasihnya Ita, menjadi renggang.

programme.title: Gemerlapan

Namun, hidup mereka mula berubah apabila mereka menemui sebuah beg sampah yang dipenuhi dengan wang tunai, yang kemudian mereka gunakan untuk membayar hutang.

programme.title: Langit

programme.title: Prebet Sapu
programme.desc: Pada 2018, Aman berpindah dari Pahang ke Kuala Lumpur mengejar impian menjadi penulis, namun hidupnya penuh kesusahan—dihalau dari bilik sewa, terpaksa tidur di kereta, dan menjadi pemandu e-hailing secara haram kerana buta warna. Hidupnya berubah apabila bertemu Bella, seorang penumpang yang menawarkan tempat tinggal dengan syarat Aman menjadi pemandu peribadinya. Persahabatan terjalin, tetapi konflik menanti. Bagaimana nasib kedua-dua jiwa miskin bandar ini akan terungkai?

programme.title: Sifu & Tongga

programme.title: This City Never Sleeps & What's On Today
programme.desc: SLF International Group Chairman Kun Chi Sam (John Chiang) is an influential figure in Macao. This business tycoon arranges for his two sons, Kun Hao In (Julian Cheung) and Kun Hao Kuan (Ron Ng), to serve as Co-CEOs of the group, placing them on equal footing. Hao In always regards Hao Kuan as a thorn in his side. To dismantle the powerful syndicate of Hao Kuan and his wife Wong Suet Ying (Kelly Cheung), Hao In announces his marriage to Hong Kong prosecutor Hung Hoi Wan (Samantha Ko). Hoi Wan and Suet Ying both hail from R. Cino Outubro and were once buddies. However, Suet Ying became the other woman and snatched Hoi Wan's boyfriend as she wanted to marry into a wealthy family. Hao In intends to take advantage of Hoi Wan's hatred by turning it into some weapon to attack Hao Kuan and his wife. In a situation where every family member seems to be scheming, Hao Kuan adheres to righteous principles and boldly deals with Hao In's relentless maneuvers.

programme.title: Like Mother, Like Daughter
programme.desc: Public relations queen TONG MAN-LEI (Jinny Ng) raises her Gen Z daughter TONG SUM ( Desta Lee) alone and she is a control freak. MAN-LEI's mother, TONG CHO KA-BING (Stephanie Che), has spent half of her life supporting her husband and raising their children. She is suddenly "awakened" and she returns to Hong Kong from Canada. She decides to reclaim her lost time and she moves into MAN-LEI's home. Many years ago, KA-BING and her daughter completely fell out because MAN-LEI insisted to have her daughter out of wedlock. Now, KA-BING suddenly breaks in without warning and disrupts MAN-LEI's life. MAN-LEI strives to maintain order, while TONG SUM mediates between the two, creating sparks and constant conflicts in this three-generation household. In the workplace, the wealthy heir, “Marketing Guru” YEUNG FAN (Gary Chiu), is parachuted into the company to lock horns with MAN-LEI on equal footing. MAN-LEI's career and family are facing crises at the same time.

programme.title: Scoop 2026
programme.desc: "Scoop" airs from Monday to Sunday, closely following major social events and interesting stories, while also reporting the latest updates in the entertainment industry, celebrity news, as well as drama promotions and behind-the-scenes features. The in-depth feature section explores current affairs, social, and livelihood issues that the public cares about, interviewing relevant experts for their insights.

programme.title: Big Feast Duel
programme.desc: With expert evaluations from renowned chefs and rigorous testing from food connoisseurs, forty restaurants compete to become the top ten culinary representatives! TV King Moses Chan and TV Queen Katy Kung transform into "Food Guru," meticulously selecting the strongest food guide for the Greater Bay Area based on ten themes including baked pork chop rice, wonton noodles, French toast, roast pigeon, hamburgers, and shrimp dumplings. The team delves into the heart of the restaurants, uncovering their little-known culinary stories. A tasting team composed of renowned chefs, well-known food critics, and discerning celebrities will also secretly visit restaurants, bringing back their honest reviews to the studio. After a round of debate and critique, the top-rated restaurants for each theme will be crowned! Viewers can also vote for their "favorite dish."

programme.title: Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils (2021)
programme.desc: Mr. Jin Yong created a magnificent martial arts world for readers, and *Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils* is one of the most beloved and sought-after masterpieces in his novel series. Its classic status is self-evident, and it remains a popular subject for adaptation. Set in the Northern Song Dynasty during the reign of Emperor Zhezong, the story follows the adventures, love, and hatred of three characters: Qiao Feng (played by Yang Youning), the leader of the Beggars' Sect; Duan Yu (played by Bai Shu), the prince of Dali; and Xu Zhu (played by Zhang Tianyang), a young monk from Shaolin Temple. It also explores the complex web of martial arts grudges and the inescapable cycle of greed, anger, and delusion, painting a vivid picture of human relationships and symbolizing that all beings in the world are ultimately bound by the painful entanglements brought about by "love."

programme.title: Big City Shop 2026
programme.desc: “Big City Shop” introduces viewers to a wide range of timely topics, including seasonal products, health and wellness, fitness activities, skincare and makeup, fashion apparel, infant care, parenting knowledge, local delicacies, and pet care trends. The content is all-encompassing! In addition to hands-on demonstrations, experiences, or tests by the hosts, experts are invited to share their professional insights. In the cooking segment, several skilled culinary experts take turns showcasing simple and delicious healthy dishes and home-style recipes, helping everyone solve their cooking challenges.

programme.title: Happy Old Buddies
programme.desc: Many people may think that older adults do not have sexual needs, but surveys have shown that this is not the case—older adults often experience less sexual activity due to various reasons. Clinical psychologist Lin Haoming from the Social Welfare Department explains the World Health Organization's definition of sexuality and offers advice for those hoping to rekindle their sex life with their partner. However, if one partner does not wish to resume sexual activity, how should both sides communicate?

programme.title: Gourmet Express
programme.desc: Hong Kong brings together global cuisines, and its unique dishes and down-to-earth fare have captured the close attention of discerning food lovers! Food hosts and presenters such as Icy Wong,Snowy Choi,Carmen Ngai,Carmaney Wong , Jessica Liu , Gillian Ng keep up with the latest food news and deals, delving into the stories behind the flavors. Gathering firsthand information on popular eateries across various platforms, the hosts personally line up and taste the food, providing genuine reviews. Even takeout-only eateries with no dine-in option are in high demand—what are the must-try picks? Running a food business inevitably comes with its own mix of sweet, sour, bitter, and spicy experiences. The production team follows the proprietors through their busy day, from sourcing ingredients and preparing materials to opening for business, uncovering the "stories behind the flavors."

programme.title: Mean Talk
programme.desc: The brand-new, unconventional talk show "Mean Talk" hosts Bob Lam and Elena Kong invite celebrity guests each episode to boldly speak the truth in the most "Mean" way. Content includes the most frustrating experiences since entering the industry, the most unbelievable entertainment secrets, the most blunt and provocative remarks, and the most scandalous programs of their film and television careers! To qualify as "Mean Talk," guests must lower their standards and be "Mean" to others. Before the interview, guests must sign a "Mean Confession Voucher," promising to reveal their true feelings, answer randomly selected questions honestly, and speak the truth anonymously!

programme.title: Hands Up 2026
programme.desc: The brand-new children's program “Hands Up” encourages kids to ask questions bravely, express themselves, and pursue their goals! Members of the mascot “Sauce Family” join the hosts in performing short skits, accompanying everyone for joyful moments. The show will also feature a variety of children's songs, allowing kids to sing along while learning practical life knowledge.

programme.title: Narcotics Heroes
programme.desc: Against the backdrop of neon lights in Hong Kong, there is a hidden dark side that nobody knows - the city is the hub of narcotics from all over the world. Rewind ten years and Narcotics Bureau has apprehended Man Wah, aka Drug Lord (Moses Chan). However, undercover officer Ip Ho-tin (Edwin Siu) is sacrificed as he is injected with a colossal dose of dope, and he has since lost his feelings. Fast-forward ten years and Man Wah suffers from cancer and is given pardon and released from prison. He seemingly lives out the rest of his life by running some upstairs bookstore. Actually, he covertly asks his old love Cheung Lam (Nancy Wu) and a dumb guy called Tsui On-lok (Matthew Ho) to engage in online drug dealing. And he uses Cheung Lam's status in the financial field for money laundering in the stock market. A missing police officer case sends shock waves across Hong Kong. Ho-tin is reassigned back to Narcotics Bureau to collaborate with his ex-girlfriend Ting Yeuk-ning (Kelly Cheung). A “war on drugs" again breaks out …

programme.title: Cantoxicating! (Sr.4)
programme.desc: The Cantonese word "gaigui" (??) is vivid and profound, with many Hong Kong slang terms originating from various parts of Guangdong Province. Gaigui Ambassador Mayanne Mak has expanded her exploration to China, inviting Tang Chi-kin, Thye Cho-yee, and Hui Man-hin to join the "Gaigui Guided Tour" to delve into inland cities like Guangzhou, uncovering interesting anecdotes and origins. Professional Cantonese and historical experts will also appear, tracing origins and citing classical texts to reveal the charm of local Cantonese. Furthermore, Tang Chi-kin, who enjoys playing pranks, will transform into a single, nerdy man on the show, showcasing his pursuit of various "goddesses" and helping viewers understand the meanings of many slang terms and idioms.

programme.desc: Elena Kong once again leads the team, joining forces with Cheung Chun-long, Chu Man-han, Ng Yip-kwan, and Tseng Zhan-wang to form the "Try It Out Team," returning with acclaim after the hit first season and enthusiastic praise from netizens. This new in-depth exploration of Taiwan will see the team continue their relaxed, authentic, and down-to-earth style, guiding viewers deep into the island's heart. The team travels to Kaohsiung, Tainan, and Taipei, continuing the show's spirit by uncovering controversial shops with polarized online reviews, as well as hidden gems and little-known experiences tucked away in the city's corners. The team is committed to presenting the most genuine on-site feedback, aiming to create a practical travel guide to Taiwan that avoids pitfalls for viewers.

programme.title: A Date with Goddess (Sr.2)
programme.desc: The dating reality show "A Date with Goddess" is back with a bang, and the second season's love battlefield is all upgraded! "Golden Matchmaker" Bob Lam is recruiting men from around the world to pair up goddesses Ho Pei-Chia, Kuo Pei-Wen, Chen Ruo-Si, Yu Ke-Cheng, and Yuen Ka-Man. The brave suitors face challenges like pressing the "heart-fluttering light" and a date at the Five Corners, each employing their own unique strategies to win over the goddesses. One-on-one intimate games ignite heart-pounding excitement, and a hidden goddess joins the fray, further intensifying the sparks… More challenges await, and the brave suitors strive to reach the end and capture the goddesses' hearts! In addition, the five goddesses from last season, along with celebrity guests, take turns becoming the "Peanut Team," providing live coverage of the goddesses' dates.

The hosts personally sample the food and provide honest reviews; they uncover hidden gems in different districts and invite long-time expatriates to visit their favorite hometown eateries; renowned chefs and food critics also guide the way, offering expert recommendations. The program features a selection of popular restaurants featured in "Food News Report," highlighting their signature dishes and delivering quick deals, ensuring viewers stay up-to-date with the most delicious and affordable dining information.

programme.title: The Ahistoric Grandpa Cooking Show (Sr.5)
programme.desc: Li Jiading (Master Ding), the tough guy, is undoubtedly a master of martial arts, but it turns out his culinary skills are equally impressive! Master Ding has set up "Master Ding's Kitchen," partnering with the discerning food connoisseur Tan Yuying. Each episode takes viewers on a sourcing trip for their favorite ingredients, and Master Ding personally cooks a variety of his signature dishes, soups, and desserts, offering a taste of nostalgic Cantonese cuisine! How to cook authentic traditional salt-baked chicken at an affordable price? How to control the heat and time when steaming fish? In autumn and winter, many people love fragrant claypot rice, especially the crispy rice crust. But have you ever seen claypot rice with crispy rice on both sides? Watch Master Ding show off his skills and teach you how!

programme.title: Le Grand Tour de Seoul
programme.desc: Amidst the ebb and flow of time, local shops that depict the microcosm of the city are becoming increasingly rare. Yet, they are a vital part of the city's structure and an irreplaceable embodiment of the Hong Kong spirit. With this in mind, the down-to-earth host, Louis Yuen, leads viewers on a shop-by-shop exploration, visiting time-honored and modern shops across four key areas of daily life: clothing, food, housing, and transportation. He reveals the shops' operating history, the hardships of maintaining them, and the stories behind generations, using these tangible shops to preserve intangible memories and showcasing the enduring beauty of "small spaces."

programme.title: Hong Kong Good Take
programme.desc: Hong Kong possesses a unique urban character, where old and new coexist, and its diverse cultures blend seamlessly, creating a series of captivating scenes under the interplay of light and shadow! Hosts Chris Lai and Winki Lai guide viewers through different movie locations, revisiting classic scenes and memorable quotes, evoking touching memories. Follow the program's carefully selected routes to admire the dazzling cityscape and immerse yourself in the world of cinema. The hosts will also demonstrate photo-taking techniques, teaching viewers how to capture the unique charm of this "City of Light and Shadow" with their cameras. In addition, film actors revisit filming locations, reminiscing about their past shoots; action directors share their insights on designing action scenes, showcasing the allure of Hong Kong cinema.

programme.title: Mystery Files
programme.desc: Love is an extremely complex subject, surrounded by numerous “environmental factors” that can alter our dreams and understanding of romance. These factors—ranging from changes in age and the rise of internet culture to the emergence of scams and other seemingly unusual reasons—have led to bizarre, worldview-shattering love stories in society. The TVB Plus live show " Mystery Files" hosted by Fire Lee, Jinny Ng, and Randal Tsang, invites people from all walks of life, celebrity guests, and relationship experts to discuss each episode's theme. With unique perspectives and thought-provoking questions, they boldly explore emotional dilemmas, while also welcoming viewers to join the conversation and solve problems together through the live chatroom and call-ins.

programme.title: You Are Not Alone Again
programme.desc: "'You Are Not Alone' triumphantly returns! In its second season, the show is once again led by the 'King of Ghosts' Leung Si Ho, together with co-hosts Wong Yiu Ying and Wong Chi Yan, as well as editors Wong Ying Yeuk and Tong Chi Yan, bringing audiences even more frights and surprises. Each episode focuses on a different supernatural theme, featuring heavyweight guests who share ghost stories and reveal the secrets of rituals and industry customs. With a world full of mysteries, the program gathers paranormal news from around the globe, and Chi Yan will travel to South Korea and Taiwan to explore local supernatural phenomena. Real-time interaction with the audience is also a highlight of 'Spirit Connection,' with the team closely following live broadcasts,

programme.title: News Roundup
programme.desc: Reporting major news from Hong Kong, across the Taiwan Strait, and around the world, as well as sports updates, keeping you informed about important events and trends in the world of sports.

programme.title: ChatSAT
programme.desc: It will do its utmost to gather the trendiest and latest information from around the world, covering everything from global events, medical encyclopedias, arts, and technology to daily life and trending online topics, sharing them with the audience every Saturday. By discussing everything under the sun and chatting about the hottest topics, “Group friend” listeners can easily stay up to date with global trends by following the program.

programme.title: Man Who Kills Troubles, The
programme.desc: K works as a fixer for Kiu Yeh, the triad leader of Hung Wo, in Melbourne. In his last mission in Melbourne, Kiu Yeh himself is found dead at the scene and K is framed for being the murderer. K also saves Jovy who has fainted in the burning building. Kiu Yeh's successor, Kiu Yik Fong, orders John to kill K. John shoots K in the head with an empty bullet to fake his death and then arranges for him to assume a new identity. K chooses to go to Hong Kong as his late girlfriend's family is there and he wants to take care of them for her. His girlfriend was Chloe and she died in a lab explosion that has been concluded as an accident. In Hong Kong, K becomes O Sir, a Physical Education teacher. His students include Ko Chun, Chloe's younger brother. He also chooses to live next door to the Ko family. 2 years later, Jovy turns up at the school as a music teacher and she is partnered with O Sir to handle Ko Chun's class. Together, they help their students with their problems including run-ins with triad members. Jovy reminds O Sir of Chloe as they share many similarities while Jovy herself starts to develop feelings for O Sir. Due to Jovy's family background which exposes her to danger, O Sir has to secretly step in to save her. But how long can O Sir keep his identity a secret? He also discovers that Chloe's death wasn't accidental. So, why did she have to die and who killed her? As Man Sir digs deeper into the triad cases, it changes his life forever. What happened to make him turn from a good cop into a bad one?

programme.title: Brutally Young
programme.desc: Rewind eighteen years and Lam Long-sang (Shaun Tam), Sum King-yat (Joel Chan), Tse Ka-fu (Anthony Ho) and their chums are members of a public housing estate youth septet. They clash with a rascal by the name of Wu Kai-sze, who ultimately collapses and dies. The septet gradually drift apart. They eventually go their separate ways and forget their past. Fast-forward eighteen years and while the police are investigating a traffic accident, they discover Kai-sze's remains. The septet are forced to face up to the disaster they had caused. While the chums are feeling confused, Long-sang is even more perplexed as he and Crime Unit Inspector Yuen Lai-kan (Mandy Wong), who is assigned this human remains case, begin to have affectionate feelings for each other. Meanwhile, Lai-kan's father Yuen Tsun (Dominic Lam) is also covertly unraveling the case and seems to have something to do with the remains. The septet are getting jittery as the truth is surfacing. Who really is the perpetrator?

programme.title: Justice Of Life, The
programme.desc: Mingtian, formerly a powerful figure in the underworld, was devastated by the accidental death of his fiancée during a business deal. Determined to turn over a new leaf, he runs a social club to make a living. Mingtian lives with his mother, uncle He Yingbiao, and cousin He Xinmiao. Yingbiao harbors suspicions that Mingtian was responsible for his dismissal from the police force, and frequently attacks him. Mingtian, however, doesn't hold a grudge. Xinmiao idolizes Mingtian, and the two are like brothers, much to Yingbiao's frustration. Since his fiancée's death, Mingtian's heart has been at peace, but his encounters with Yu Wenqian and Ruan Daiyu stir up his romantic life. Xinmiao, misled by his father, becomes involved in drug trafficking. To save Xinmiao, Mingtian teams up with his old friend, police inspector Ma Shixiong, to fight against the gangsters.

programme.title: From Hong Kong To Beijing
programme.desc: Chui Kong-yan (Ruco Chan), member of a property management company top management, is a lucky guy as his career keeps progressing well. However, he and his wife Helen Kwong (Jinny Ng) inadvertently fall for some investment scam and suffer heavy losses. Kong-yan is reassigned to a branch office as CEO in Beijing. He regards this as an opportunity to turn the situation around, so he and Helen go to the North to start over. But he is affected by a midlife crisis. Kong-yan is actually demoted because of Ding Chi-keung, who used to be his arch enemy. To save face, he just has to stay put. He then again runs into Su Fei (Jacky Cai), who he has not seen for many years, and his marriage is under strain. Gourmet influencer Chui Kong-man (Tony Leung) and busker Chui Po-yee (Joey Thye) each have their reasons for going to the North to seek refuge with their big brother Kong-yan. The family members keep brainstorming and want to transform an abandoned transformer house into a creative park. Kong-yan, who follows Buddhistism, really has to engage in a tough battle for his life!

programme.title: Legend of The Condor Heroes 1994, The
programme.desc: In the Sung Dynasty, the Kwok's and the Yeung's were being wiped out. Luckily, Ching (Julian Cheung) from the Kwok's survived and was brought up by the Seven Strangers in the desert. The Seven Strangers also taught him their Kungfu. Then, he met the lovely and witty Yung (Athena Chu) and they fell in love with each other. They set out for a journey and met Kung (Lau Dan) and Tung (Lai Yiu Cheung). They both taught Ching their knowledge in Kungfu.

programme.title: Life After Death
programme.desc: Seven years ago, a serious car accident shattered two families and changed the lives of Jiang Yucheng (Frankie Lam) and Fang Lewen (Priscilla Wong). Seven years later, another traffic accident brings Yucheng back to Lewen, and life continues with its share of joys and sorrows. Lewen and her sister Fang Shuwen (Shiga Lin) have a falling out as those around them leave one by one, but the eccentric doctor Gu Xichen (Ma Guandong) manages to get to the root of the problem. Lewen is busy taking care of her daughter Zhu Xing'er and stepson Zhu Jiabing (Gu Dingxuan), while Yucheng has yet to understand the needs of his only daughter Jiang Ziyou (Su Haoer). Ziyou and Jiabing grow closer, but their mutual friend Mo Yuqian (Li Renshen) creates more problems for them, and the truth behind the car accident gradually resurfaces, forcing everyone to face change once again…

programme.title: Love As A Predatory Affair
programme.desc: Food supplier LO KAI-FONG (Kitty Yuen) is a short, average, thirtysomething dating virgin, and she serendipitously helps a young restaurateur, LAU PAK-YIP (Jason Chan), overcome adversity, making this drop-dead gorgeous uncover and value her inner beauty. Gradually, their love grows, which KAI-FONG's neighbour and best friend, KO KWAI-FUN (Samantha Ko), cannot let go of. Though fish peddler KWAI-FUN, whose beauty resembles a stunning diva, tries every means possible to flirt with PAK-YIP, she still cannot create any chemistry with him. Unexpectedly, HUNG SIN (King Kong), heir to a Taiwanese Tan-Tsu noodles business, begins to take a fancy to KWAI-FUN, and he even roughs it in the subdivided flat together with KAI-FONG and the others so as to get to know KWAI-FUN better. Since KWAI-FUN's effort goes unnoticed by PAK-YIP, she shifts her focus to court his uncle, LAU LEI-KO (Timothy Cheng). Later on, facing growing negative criticism over his girlfriend KAI-FONG, PAK-YIP cannot bear it anymore, which eventually sours his relationship with KAI-FONG. When there's no such thing as unconditional love, and the line between good and bad becomes blurred, love transforms to a predatory affair, catapulting everyone, both male and female, to the brink of war......

programme.title: Justice Sung Begins
programme.desc: Against a backdrop of the Qing era, due to his father Sung On (Cheung Tat Ming) working as a prison guard, smart and clever Sung Sai-kit (Vincent Wong) has witnessed all kinds of unjust things as he has been wandering around within the prison walls since his childhood, causing him not to believe there is justice in the legal field. After reaching adulthood, Sai-kit also does not want to become an imperial official even though he is well educated. He just covertly helps a fellow student called Ho Sau-shun (Lam Tsz Chung) pass his exam. And Sai-kit and his brother Sung Ah-kau (King Kong) follow a nomadic lifestyle. However, Sai-kit is then embroiled in the Murderous Spider Demoness Case. To find the perpetrator, he shows off his finesse as Pleader. During the process, he also meets brothel bouncer Ling Lung (Elaine Yu), who is a proficient combat fighter. The case is concluded, and Sai-kit and Ling Lung get married. He also properly goes down the road to working as a Pleader. Moreover, he has to deal with successive complicated big cases.

programme.title: Will Power
programme.desc: Cha Sing-yu (Hacken Lee), who grew up in the United States, returned to Hong Kong alone due to his dissatisfaction with his mother's remarriage, reuniting with his father and twin brother Sing-chau (Paul Wong). Under his father's arrangement, Sing-yu enrolled in the same school as his younger brother to study Form 7, where he met his classmates Chang Yan-ran (Yu Sin-man), Li Xi-xi (Mui Siu-wai), Xu Yi (Aaron Kwok), Dr. (Wong Ka-keung), and their homeroom teacher Chang Yan-ran (Sheung Tin-ngor).

It encapsulates the conflicts caused by discrimination as well as differences in social-cultural background, lifestyle and family values between the races. The movie also combines tears, joy and laughter with song and dance.

programme.title: Tales From The Occult: Body And Soul
programme.desc: This horror anthology series returns to feature three spooky crime stories about an ex-hair model, a cat lover and the love triangle between a dental nurse, a dentist and a chef. The stories depict their paths from obsession to madness, eventually tipping them over to the dark side of human nature.

programme.title: The Myth
programme.desc: Guided by mysterious dreams, archaeologist Jack discovers he was General Meng Yi in a past life and shared a tragic love with Princess Ok-Soo that spanned a thousand years. When they reunite in Emperor Qin's celestial palace, a ruthless tycoon seeks the secret of immortality. Reclaiming his past strength, Jack faces a final battle of destiny.

programme.title: Everything Under Control
programme.desc: During a diamond heist, one of the security escorts, Jelly, steals the diamonds and flees. Fellow security escorts, Yau Shing and Penguin, are forced to help the robber track down the diamonds. They stumble onto a remote village along the way, encountering strange villagers and mysterious incidents. Can they finally locate Jelly and the diamonds?

programme.title: Love Never Ends
programme.desc: An empty-nest elderly man and a widowed elderly woman who collects scrap, meet unexpectedly and gradually develop feelings for each other. An elderly couple whose wife suffers from a serious illness, makes a living by selling scrap. Both these elderly couples fall deeply in love and prove that love never ends, even if there is no tomorrow!

programme.title: The Last Tycoon
programme.desc: Gangster Chen Da Qi rises to the upper echelons of power, but finds himself torn between the love of two women, the murderous plots of the secret service, and the looming threat of war.

programme.title: Burning Stars
programme.desc: Set in 1920s Shanghai under the shadow of White Terror, agent Li Yi Min is tasked with escorting a key figure to safety. He reunites with former allies to break through deadly traps. Amid the turmoil, a group of idealistic youths join the cause, risking everything to uphold the mission and find courage in a time of chaos.

programme.title: Mama's Affair
programme.desc: Former talent manager Mei Fung stays home to take care of her husband and son after retirement. She decides to re-enter the entertainment business to find her value in life, and successfully transforms a local restaurant delivery boy, Fong Ching, into a young pop idol. This makes her teenage son, Jonathan, intensely jealous of Fong Ching.

programme.title: Out of Order
programme.desc: A successful lawyer's secret affair turns into a nightmare when a corpse unexpectedly turns up in the hotel room, triggering a desperate cover-up that spirals into uncontrollable chaos.

programme.title: Tales from the Occult
programme.desc: The movie consists of three tales about the horrors lurking in dark corners of the city. A young pop star goes back into depression when spooky things happen in her new home; an online influencer performs live in a mall, but it ends up being a livestream of his death; the residents of a tenement building battle a mysterious figure in the stairwell.

programme.title: The Medallion
programme.desc: Hong Kong detective Eddie dies while rescuing a mystical child during an international search for a human trafficking syndicate. Revived by the sacred Medallion, he gains extraordinary healing powers. However, when his ruthless nemesis also seizes its power, Eddie must storm a sinister castle and fight in a brutal battle for survival.

programme.title: Possession Street
programme.desc: When seven vengeful spirits turn the tenants of an abandoned mall into zombies, a video store owner, his daughter and a feng shui master must fight for survival. As the undead multiply and the evil spirits grow stronger, they race to stop the haunting before the entire mall descends into a living hell.

programme.title: Cesium Fallout
programme.desc: A massive fire caused by illegal garbage smuggling has triggered a radiation crisis in Hong Kong. Government advisor Simon joins the crisis response team led by Acting Chief Executive to avert the disaster. A fire brigade is tasked to enter the radiation zone and stop the cesium fallout. Facing the unprecedented catastrophe, can they save the city?

programme.title: Pursuit
programme.desc: This movie tells the tale of Lin Chong, the Sung Dynasty's Chief Army Instructor who is framed by a corrupt official and has to embark on an exile fraught with danger. Helped by a monk, Lin Chong is finally able to take revenge.

programme.title: Gossip Street
programme.desc: All neighbours gather to gossip in flat number 8 on the second floor of the Gossip Street apartment building! Most of the residents are common people from all walks of life and there is never a lack of laughter or sarcasm in the neighbourhood. However, when a local mobster wants to change the place into a gambling den, things get serious...

programme.title: Killers Five
programme.desc: The Duke's daughter has been kidnapped by the notorious Golden Dragon Hill bandits. A swordman named Yue Zhen Bei is assigned to save her, and expecting many dangers on the journey, Yue garners help from a group of good friends who are also kung fu masters.

programme.title: Sex, Love and Hate
programme.desc: This masterpiece spins three interconnected tales about Hong Kong society's differing views on love and what women want from love. Follow a trio of Hong Kong women as they explore relationships and fulfil their hopes of finding true love.

programme.title: Shaolin Martial Arts
programme.desc: The Qing government assigns fighters to destroy Shaolin Temple and kill all the disciples, but two of them successfully escaped. They train under different masters and learn the Wing Chun and Hung Quan styles respectively, finally killing the fighters and taking revenge for the death of their fellow disciples.

programme.title: The 36th Chamber of Shaolin
programme.desc: Gordon Liu plays an anti-Manchu rebel who escapes to the Shaolin Temple and learns what it truly takes to become a martial arts master by challenging the 35 Shaolin Kung Fu chambers, eventually creating the 36th chamber himself.

programme.title: Family Light Affair
programme.desc: Alfred Cheung Kin-ting returns to the screen with this seriocomic look at the clash of cultures which result when a Mainland Chinese peasant brings his family to Hong Kong. Family Light Affair, whose Chinese title literally translates as "City Lights", is the director/writer's warm-hearted memoir of street life back in the early 1980s, featuring an eclectic cast of pop music and kung fu stars who shine in their poignant roles.

programme.title: The Five Venoms
programme.desc: A dying master dispatches his last pupil to track down five ex-students who are each an expert in his own lethal combat style. He fears they will steal the fortune belonging to their clan and tasks his pupil to prevent their attempt.

programme.title: Rose, Be My Love
programme.desc: Not a love triangle but a love 'rectangle', Rose, Be My Love is a romantic drama set on the eve of World War II that represents the high standards achieved by Shaw Brothers in both aspects of star power and technical polish.

programme.title: Rape of the Sword
programme.desc: The film starts out with two students fighting for their deceased master's sword called the "Green Frost Sword". Han kills the other student, takes the sword and offer it to the king. The wife of the other dead student plots to take revenge, going undercover to retrieve the sword at the first opportunity in this tale of revenge and betrayal.

programme.title: The Mermaid
programme.desc: Impoverished scholar Zhang Zhen seeks refuge with a chancellor's family, only to be scorned for his poverty. A carp spirit, moved by his plight, disguises herself as the chancellor's daughter and falls for him. Confusion over the two identical daughters draws a demon-hunting priest. Zhang Zhen refuses to abandon her, moving Guanyin to grant her mortal form.

programme.title: The 14 Amazons
programme.desc: The Yang family had served their country in Song Dynasty for generations. When General Yang is ambushed and killed during the war in Jin Shan, the grand matriarch led the entire family to take revenge and defend the country.

programme.title: King Drummer

The new drummer becomes an immediate hit, causing Charlie to be very jealous. Furthermore, the young drummer's mother is dead set against him having a music career.

programme.title: The Monkey Goes West

Kong covets the beauty of Sing's wife and casts an evil love spell on her, while threatening to kill Sing at the same time. Can Sing save his wife and his patients?

programme.title: Animals Like Us

programme.title: Animals Like Us
